title: Frontiers: ChatGPT Referrals to E-Commerce Websites: How Do LLMs Compare Against Traditional Channels?
eligible_reason: Descriptive comparison of conversion, order value and engagement across traffic channels (ChatGPT referrals vs others) for 973 e-commerce sites; regressions on channel + hostname + device + month dummies. No treatment adoption or DiD.
design_notes: 1_main.R: speedglm/lm of CR, AOV, RPS, BR, SD, PV on channel + hostname + devicecategory + month (weighted); time-varying robustness with channel x time trends (sigmoid/gompertz/linear).
data_provenance_note: Aggregated analysis data as used in the paper.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Descriptive; out of scope.
